regime_field: data part: D (bootstrap tables only); names part (names_s2.json): D+K, K = variable names read by the model
split_field: row 'group': live:* and replay:*:dev are dev; replay:formula:test is test; names_s2.json uses the S2 test arms; exploratory_s2_live.json is labelled exploratory (those tables were read in BND-10)

controls.columns_shuffled: per-row (formula replays: per-file permutation; S2: shuffled by the suite; dev live tables: as recorded)

orientation_rule: dir_f1_random: undecided pairs oriented at random with seed crc32(key); dir_f1_committed: committed arrows only (refinement_v1.scores, imported unchanged)

metric_defs.dir_f1_random: directed-edge F1, undecided pairs oriented at random (per-file seed)
